anchors.exact_quote: The low temperature (LT) cooling water temperature control works similarly to the HT cooling water temperature control and can be used if the LT cooling water system is designed as one individual cooling water system per engine. In case several engines are operated with a combined LT cooling water system, it is necessary to use an external temperature controller. This external controller must be mounted on the engine control room desk and is to be wired to the temperature control valve.
